## `pygeovision.reporting.geo`

Raster measurements for reports: areas, class tables, statistics, binning.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `bbox_area_km2` | function | Geodesic area of a lon/lat box in km2. |
| `ellipsoid_row_areas_ha` | function | Area in ha of one cell in each of ``n_rows`` rows of a lon/lat grid (exact on the WGS84 ellipsoid). |
| `row_pixel_area_ha` | function | Area of one pixel in each raster row, in hectares. |
| `ClassTable` | class |  |
| `class_table` | function | Pixel counts and areas per class value, over valid pixels. |
| `read_band` | function | Band as float32 with nodata -> NaN, plus the dataset's georeferencing info. |
| `continuous_summary` | function | Descriptive statistics over the finite pixels of ``arr``. |
| `apply_binning` | function | Classify ``arr`` by ``b``. Returns uint8 classes (255 = invalid) and the class definitions. |
| `table_from_classes` | function | Class table for an in-memory class array (used for binned continuous layers). |
| `aoi_extent_wgs84` | function | Raster bounds as (west, south, east, north) in degrees. |
